workingTree: Original 14 tracked and 6 untracked WIP retained; owned source is published
review: The admitted program already owns cancellation contour admission; general unwind naming makes the same private authority available to lifecycle traps. Bank aggregate remains the sole actual grant/body retirement owner. All production consumers migrated directly; no alias, wire format, Cargo edge or public visibility changed.

Product lifecycle remains responsible for line reconciliation, cleanup effects and terminal flow publication. Actual bank contour preflight precedes reconciliation commit; actual retirement precedes cleanup dispatch. Typed refusal classification is owned by ProductStepError and reused by main, selected child and withdrawn Dialogue transaction owners, without a string decoder or fallback ledger.

New trap_lifecycle.rs grows from zero and crosses the 300-LOC review trigger. Its one responsibility is lifecycle/refusal behavior across real execution owners; its sole module importer is presentation.rs and its fan-out is existing Core fixture, VM, bank and public-save APIs. Actual child identity is allocated by the existing executor cursor; Dialogue is issued by a real terminator. Nested program construction is shared with the prior trap tests inside test-only visibility. No test widens production APIs or synthesizes a ledger identity.

The new 51-line ProductStepBudgets context owns one-step replenishment requests for actual main and activation VM quanta. It is ephemeral, non-Clone/non-Serde, and holds no runtime custody. Activation preparation now runs inside the existing complete checkpoint; the obsolete pre-ingress transaction/commit method was deleted. Zero elapsed time still authenticates Duration waits but restores the unchanged registry transaction.

ProductActivationProgress carries a typed terminal trap together with its already admitted cleanup execution batch. The actual fiber remains the terminal-state owner; the returned trap is its report to failure-close preparation. All internal constructors/callers migrate directly. Valid trap observations no longer trigger checkpoint rollback and discard successful retirement.

The final lifecycle module additionally verifies zero-operation public steps and public save/restore of a real active Dialogue resource. Actual physical LOC and byte sizes below supersede the initial checkpoint measurements; all earlier source epochs remain in raw evidence.
